changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.IDEMPOTENCY_KEYS ( IDEM_KEY VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, SOURCE_CHANNEL VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) NOT NULL, SOURCE_REF VARCHAR2(256 CHAR), PROCESSED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, RESULT_REF NUMBER(19), CONSTRAINT PK_IDEM PRIMARY KEY (IDEM_KEY), CONSTRAINT CK_IDEM_CHANNEL CHECK (SOURCE_CHANNEL IN ('HTTP','KAFKA','MQ')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (PROCESSED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(1, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
